description: This file contains the implementation of the agent run execution logic, including fallback handling, session management, error handling, and integration with CLI and embedded agents within a conversational AI framework.

methods.name: setFallbackSelectionStateField
methods.description: Sets a specific fallback selection state field in a session entry, returning true if a change was made.

methods.name: snapshotFallbackSelectionState
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the current fallback selection state from a session entry.

methods.name: buildFallbackSelectionState
methods.description: Constructs a fallback selection state object from given parameters.

methods.name: applyFallbackSelectionState
methods.description: Applies a fallback selection state to a session entry, updating fields and timestamps.

methods.name: rollbackFallbackSelectionStateIfUnchanged
methods.description: Reverts fallback selection state in a session entry if it matches expected previous state.

methods.name: buildRateLimitCooldownMessage
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly message indicating rate limit cooldown time based on error info.

methods.name: isPureTransientRateLimitSummary
methods.description: Checks if an error is a transient rate limit summary with only rate_limit or overloaded reasons.

methods.name: isToolResultTurnMismatchError
methods.description: Detects if a message indicates a tool result turn mismatch error.

methods.name: buildExternalRunFailureText
methods.description: Creates a user-facing error message for external run failures, especially tool turn mismatches.

methods.name: runAgentTurnWithFallback
methods.description: Main function executing an agent turn with fallback, handling retries, errors, session management, and integration with CLI and embedded agents.
